CREATE TABLE core.events (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  source text NOT NULL,
  run_id uuid NOT NULL,
  material_id uuid,
  anchor bigint,
  ordinal smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  parents uuid[],
  ts_orig timestamptz,
  ts_quality text NOT NULL CHECK (ts_quality IN ('intrinsic', 'captured', 'file_mtime', 'operator', 'unknown')),
  ts_coided timestamptz GENERATED ALWAYS AS (uuid_extract_timestamp(id)) STORED,
  ts_persisted timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  commit_seq bigint NOT NULL,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  equivalence_key text,
  reading_order bigint NOT NULL,
  record_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  record_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'present' CHECK (record_state IN ('present', 'removed')),
  class text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (class IN ('open', 'guarded', 'sealed')),
  support jsonb,
  CONSTRAINT one_origin CHECK ((material_id IS NOT NULL AND anchor IS NOT NULL AND parents IS NULL) OR (material_id IS NULL AND anchor IS NULL AND parents IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(parents) > 0)),

  CONSTRAINT time_pair CHECK ((ts_orig IS NULL) = (ts_quality = 'unknown')),
  CONSTRAINT anchor_in_range CHECK (anchor IS NULL OR anchor >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ordinal_in_range CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT payload_object CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),
  CONSTRAINT hash_length CHECK (length(record_hash) = 32),
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE FUNCTION core.class_visible(class text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT class = 'open'
      OR class = ANY (string_to_array(coalesce(current_setting('sinex.grants', true), ''), ','))
$$

CREATE VIEW core.visible_events AS SELECT
  e.id, e.event_type, e.source, e.run_id, e.material_id, e.anchor, e.ordinal, e.parents,
  e.ts_orig, e.ts_quality, e.ts_coided, e.ts_persisted, e.commit_seq,
  CASE WHEN core.class_visible(e.class) THEN e.payload
       ELSE jsonb_build_object('withheld', e.class) END AS payload,
  CASE WHEN core.class_visible(e.class) THEN e.equivalence_key END AS equivalence_key,
  e.reading_order, e.record_hash, e.record_state, e.class, e.support
FROM core.events e

CREATE VIEW core.visible_search_text AS SELECT s.event_id, s.text, s.tsv
FROM core.search_text s JOIN core.events e ON e.id = s.event_id
WHERE core.class_visible(e.class)

registry.title: CommandExecuted
registry.description:
A command run in a shell, as Atuin recorded it. Atuin updates rows in place
(duration and exit arrive when the command ends; `deleted_at` when the
operator deletes it), so a newer reading with different content replaces
the live one.

duration_ns.description: `None` while the command is still running (Atuin stores -1).

exit_code.description:
`None` while the command is still running. Exit codes are signed: a
signal-killed command is negative.

extra.description: Columns this parser does not know yet, kept by name.

registry.title: NoteDocument

text.description: The file's text; `None` for a vanished file.

vanished_at.description: When a completed scan first found the file gone.

registry.description:
A note file in a notes vault (Obsidian, plain Markdown folders). The vault
and the path inside it identify it; an edit is a newer reading, and a file
missing from a completed scan is removed at the source.
